resources.string:
To show the charging indicator over other apps, Charge Indicator needs two permissions:

• Display pop-up windows
• Open new windows while running in the background

On the next screen, turn both on.
To show the charging indicator over other apps, Charge Indicator needs permission to display over other apps.\n\nOn the next screen, turn it on.
To show the charging indicator after the phone restarts, Charge Indicator must be allowed to start in the background.\n\nOn the next screen, find Charge Indicator and turn it on.
